noOrganization.title: You can't add schedules
noOrganization.description: Schedules are disabled for all of your organizations, or you don't have permissions to create them. An admin can enable Schedules in the organization settings, or you can create a new organization.

error.noPermission: You don't have permission to manage schedules
error.validation: Cannot save: some fields are invalid. Please review the form and try again.

share.title: Link copied
share.description: A shareable link to the schedule has been copied to the clipboard.

deleteSchedule.title: Delete schedule
deleteSchedule.description: Are you sure you want to delete the schedule "{{name}}"? This action cannot be undone.

spotify.createDescription: Creates an unlisted Spotify playlist with the {{count}} songs that have a Spotify reference.
spotify.resyncTooltip: Updates the Spotify playlist to match the current schedule
spotify.managedByTooltip: Only {{name}}, who created the playlist, can re-sync it
spotify.noSongs: No songs with a Spotify reference
spotify.syncedSkippedDescription: Songs without a Spotify reference were skipped: {{skipped}}
spotify.publicDescription: Anyone can find and open it on Spotify.
spotify.privateDescription: Only you can see it on Spotify, so other members may not be able to open it.

youtube.createDescription: Creates an unlisted YouTube playlist with the {{count}} songs that have a YouTube reference.
youtube.resyncTooltip: Updates the YouTube playlist to match the current schedule
youtube.managedByTooltip: Only {{name}}, who created the playlist, can re-sync it
youtube.noSongs: No songs with a YouTube reference
youtube.syncedSkippedDescription: Songs without an available YouTube video were skipped: {{skipped}}
youtube.publicDescription: Anyone can find it on YouTube.
youtube.privateDescription: Unlisted: anyone with the link can open it.
